title: Baobab Organisation Domain Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Definition library for Organisation and LegalEntityProfile, plus the opaque resource identifiers used across organisation/v1.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/Organisation), not the document root.

Shared = contract/schema authority and first-party governance source.
Control Plane = runtime authority for Organisation and LegalEntityProfile instances.

corporateRelationshipId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted CorporateRelationship identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

corporateGroupId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted CorporateGroup identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

corporateGroupMembershipId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted CorporateGroupMembership identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

platformRelationshipId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted PlatformRelationship identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

platformAccountId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted PlatformAccount identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

platformAccountMembershipId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted PlatformAccountMembership identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

tenantPlatformAccountBindingId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted TenantPlatformAccountBinding identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

tenantOrganisationMappingId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted TenantOrganisationMapping identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

tenantLegalEntityMappingId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted TenantLegalEntityMapping identifier. Must not embed organisation names, countries, markets or brands.

iamOrganisationReferenceId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted IamOrganisationReference identifier. Must not embed organisation names, realms, providers or brands.

platformId.description: Identifier of the Baobab Platform instance or product plane. The platform is not a legal entity (ADR-BCP-018 section 30).

evidenceReference.description: Opaque reference to evidence held in a document or evidence system (ADR-BCP-023). Evidence binaries are never embedded in these contracts.

relationshipClassification.description: Security classification of a relationship record (ADR-BCP-018 section 102). A canonical relationship is not enumerable by every tenant.

organisationForm.description: Organisational form only. MUST NOT encode commercial role (SUPPLIER/CUSTOMER).

verificationState.description: Evidence state. Consequential decisions MUST fail closed unless VERIFIED.

canonical_entity_id.description: Platform CanonicalEntity identifier. Organisation identity is never independent of CanonicalEntity.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision suffix.

source_authority.description: Authoritative source that established or last verified this Organisation record. An applicant submission is a claim, not an authority for VERIFIED state (ADR-BCP-018 section 69, ADR-BCP-023).

LegalEntityProfile.description: Legally recognised person attached to an Organisation. organisation_id and legal_entity_id remain distinct. Runtime instances are Control Plane authority; Shared governs first-party registry ids only.

legal_entity_id.description: Canonical legal-entity identifier known to Control Plane. First-party IDs reconcile to contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml; newly admitted external IDs SHOULD be opaque (LE-<token>) per ADR-BCP-018 section 12. Names, registration numbers and brands belong in legal_name, registration_identifiers and external references.

organisation_id.description: Organisation this legal person is attached to. organisation_id != legal_entity_id even when one-to-one.

evidence_references.description: Opaque references to evidence in a document system. Binaries are not stored here.

verified_by.description: Authenticated principal or governed process that performed verification. Server-derived; never accepted from applicant payloads.

allOf.description: VERIFIED is an outcome of evidence review, never of receipt of a claim.

legalStatus.description: Legal standing of the legal person as recorded by the source authority. UNKNOWN until an authoritative source has confirmed it; never guessed.
